Pick a mascot. The whole app follows.

Six themes, each a colour and a companion: Classic, Dolphin, Panda, Night Owl, Flamingo and Honeybee. The colour runs through every screen, the mascot greets you on the home screen, cheers every dose you log and rides your weight chart, and the app icon on your home screen changes with it. Classic keeps things plain.
Dolphin is free. Panda, Night Owl, Flamingo and Honeybee come with Premium. Light, dark or follow the system — your choice.
Snap your meal. See the calories.

On a GLP-1 you eat less, so what you do eat matters more. Take a photo and Dozify lists each item on the plate with an estimate of its calories and protein, in your language. It is always an editable draft: fix a portion, add what the camera missed, then save it next to your doses and weight. Your first photo is free; after that it is Premium, with a 14-day free trial.

Dozify reads exports from Shotsy, Glapp, GLPzy and GlucoPal, and any CSV with a date column. Nothing is written until you have seen what it found (how many injections, how many weights, how many notes) and a backup of your existing data is taken first. Importing costs nothing.

Walk into the appointment with a summary

A visit is ten minutes and three months. Pick the date range and what goes in it (doses, weight, side effects, your own notes and the questions you meant to ask) and Dozify builds a PDF you can print or send ahead. What it contains is your record; what it means is your doctor's call.

Medications you can track
Pick the one you were prescribed and Dozify sets up the schedule and dose steps for it. Anything not on the list you can add by hand.
Weekly injections
Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound® and Trulicity®: one shot a week, and one reminder a week to match.
Daily injections

Oral
Wegovy® pill, Ozempic® tablet, Rybelsus® and Foundayo™ — daily tablets, tracked with the same history and the same report. How pill tracking works

Is Dozify free?

Yes. Dose logging, dose reminders, injection-site rotation, weight, water and side-effect logging, your whole history and photos, the education articles and your first AI meal-photo analysis are free — dose tracking stays free forever, not for a trial window. Premium is the understanding layer: the estimated medication-level curve, advanced charts and trends, weight projection, body composition, nutrition tracking and AI photo calories after the first one, vial management, doctor PDF reports, themes, and a second active medication. Subscription and cancellation details are on the support page.
Is my data private?

Your health records (doses, weight, side effects, progress photos) are stored on your device and never uploaded. The one exception is a meal photo you choose to analyse with AI calories: it is sent, after you agree, through our server to Google Gemini and is not stored by the app. There is no account and no cloud sync, and the app shows no advertising. Anonymous usage statistics are collected so the app can be improved, and they never carry a medication name or a symptom. Dozify also measures whether an install came from one of its own App Store or Meta campaigns; that measurement runs behind Apple's tracking permission and never includes your health records. Delete the app and your records are gone.
Which medications does Dozify support?

Dozify helps you track popular GLP-1 medications, including Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Saxenda®, Trulicity®, and Victoza®, plus daily tablets: the Wegovy® pill, Ozempic® tablet, Rybelsus® and Foundayo™. These brand names are trademarks of their respective owners, and Dozify is not affiliated with these companies.
Does Dozify work without internet?
Yes. Dozify is offline-first and works fully without an internet connection. You never need to sign in or sync to use it.
Can Dozify remind me of my injection?
Yes. You can set a weekly or daily reminder that matches your medication's schedule, so it is easier to stay consistent with your routine.
Does Dozify replace my doctor?

No. Dozify is an educational tracking tool, not a medical device, and it does not provide medical advice. Always follow your doctor and your prescription — what the app refuses to do is written out in full.
Can I track weight and side effects?
Yes. You can record your weight, body measurements, and a side-effect diary, and see your trend on clear charts: including a weight projection and a time-to-goal estimate based on your own data.
Can I bring my data from another GLP-1 app?

Yes, and it is free. Export from the app you are leaving, open Settings → Import in Dozify and pick the file. It reads Shotsy, Glapp, GLPzy and GlucoPal exports and any CSV with a date column, shows you what it found (how many injections, weights and notes) before writing anything, skips records you already have, and backs up your existing data first. More on the switching page.
Is Dozify available on Android?
Not yet. Dozify is iPhone only for now, on the App Store.
